items: [Stylish Aviator Design] An elegant plastic black, tortoise, cream,pink shiny finish elevates the aviator design even further. This sleek pair is all you need to add a little more punch to your appearance. The gorgeous frame fits any face with its plush nose cushions and is ideal for any day with sunshine.
HIGH-DEFINITION UV400 LENSES – SOJOS UV400 lenses can filter out sunlight reflected glare and protect your eyes from long term damage by blocking harmful UVA and UVB rays.

These SOJOS fashion sunglasses are choice for outdoor activities such as taking selfies,shopping,driving,traveling,and are suitable as a fashion accessory and daily wear all year round.With feminine colors,these are sunglasses that you can change out with your outfits.
